value.rationale: A literature-motivated quantitative strengthening of the first-Fourier-zero counterexample: every α≥23 now works rigorously, compared with the closest explicit sufficient cutoff above 91.6. The result crosses the actual curvature-sign change and develops a reproducible oscillatory-integral positivity method. It is not a routine renaming, numerical restatement or claim of optimality; the exact threshold 23 has clear geometric significance as an explicit first counterexample for the natural family.
